components.name: hero
components.source: Retain the static hero heading, paragraph, navy/red treatment and responsive layout.
components.target: Heading, paragraph and presentation match at both viewports.

components.name: home preparation
components.source: Retain the preparation content and both resource/download entry points.
components.target: Heading and copy match; the resources link opens the intended page. Required checklist entry point returns 404.

components.name: introductory content
components.source: Retain each page main heading and its introductory guidance.
components.target: Contact and guide introductions remain matched at both sizes. Resources loses the entire H1/guidance region (F-002).
components.recommendation: Restore the resources H1 and preparation paragraph.

components.name: preparation kit
components.source: Retain the preparation list and working checklist download.
components.target: Preparation heading, three list items and download label remain. Download returns the same unavailable URL as home (F-001).
components.recommendation: Publish the approved checklist or approved replacement destination.

components.name: contact-panel
components.source: Fit all fictional contact content to its container without horizontal scrolling.
components.target: All text is retained; desktop panel matches. No form or sending service exists. Target uses a fixed 760px panel at mobile width (F-003).
components.recommendation: Remove the target-only mobile width and retest reflow.

components.name: disclosure
components.source: Retain both native details/summary controls, answers and keyboard behavior.
components.target: Both controls and answers match. Enter/Space and mouse state transitions passed at both sizes.

components.name: header
components.source: Preserve the shared header and its scoped behavior.
components.target: Matched presentation and content; all four links and route mapping work.

components.name: footer
components.source: Preserve the shared footer and its scoped behavior.
components.target: Matched presentation and content; lower-page copy retained.
